title: Enforce exclusive OSCORE receiver ownership
description: Repeated Context::load_existing calls can create concurrent receiver contexts with independent replay windows for the same durable record, so both may accept one authenticated packet. Enforce synchronized exclusive ownership or shared atomic recipient replay state. Found reviewing convergence OSCORE slice; outside frozen ledger.
notes: Not a spec gap -- runtime implementation bug. Need mutex or shared atomic replay state to prevent concurrent receivers accepting same packet. Ready for implementation.
close_reason: Fixed in f4b089027c (rust/lichen-oscore). Mechanism (a) process-wide OwnershipRegistry: claims keyed by ContextId; second register_fresh/restore_existing for a live record fails with OwnershipError::AlreadyOwned (fail closed); explicit release(); drop-without-release keeps the claim; activation failure rolls back the claim; fixed-capacity, no_std, allocation-free. WHY (a): the oscore crate derives one stable ContextId per directional context (types.rs: 'Stable identifier for one directional OSCORE sender context'), so ContextId pins exactly one recipient replay window; production call sites (lichen-node/src/secure.rs:542, lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/secure.rs:24, lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1016) use map-replace install (contexts.insert(peer_iid, ..)) and never retain two live contexts per peer, so fail-closed on double-load is tolerated and converts the silent split-brain into a loud error. Alternative (b) shared atomic replay window rejected: replay windows are ephemeral by decision on 38qm (restart clears, MUST NOT persist) and Context is a foreign re-export (path dep crates/oscore), so sharing one window across instances would require restructuring the external crate. CALL-SITE AUDIT: no site requires independent windows (escalation clause not triggered); node/gateway adoption of the registry filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-yj0c. TESTS: new tests/ownership.rs 7 tests (second activation of a live record fails AlreadyOwned after instance 1 accepted seq N; claim rollback on activation failure; distinct directional records own independently; capacity exhaustion fails closed; register_fresh exclusivity; claim survives drop until release; release of unowned record is false). Staged slice verified in isolation on HEAD in a clean worktree: cargo test -p lichen-oscore 33 passed/0 failed (1 pre-existing ignored), fmt clean, clippy --all-features and --no-default-features -D warnings clean. Full working tree: 36 passed/0 failed (existing tests green incl. vectors/parity/persistence round-trip via SenderStateStore CAS).
